# semaphore_ex_runtime_secrets (Data Source)

Reads configured runtime-secrets state and expiry without changing them. Requires administrator access and the configured-state GET endpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "semaphore_ex_runtime_secrets" "configuration" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `expires_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `state` (String)
